summary: Read two positive integers k and n. Pick exactly k different integers from 1 through 9 so that they add up to n. Write every such pick. When two picks contain the same set of integers, keep only one, even if the written order differs. When no pick works, write an empty result. Inside one pick, each integer may appear at most once.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
